newsletter.markdown:
1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

* **[Biotech]** **Washington University team demonstrates neurodegeneration reduction via T-cell restriction** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/29/health-news-researchers-slow-neurodegeneration-in-mice-t-cells/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * A mouse model study indicates that blocking specific immune cells from entering the brain can limit neurodegeneration.
* **[Biotech]** **ai3Bio launches with $48 million Series A for immune reset therapies** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/ai3bio-th17-drugs-immune-reset-launch-series-a/831521/)
  * Formed by combining Corner Therapeutics and Novasenta, ai3Bio secured $48 million to advance targeted medicines designed to reset immune systems in immunological diseases without broad immunosuppression.

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

* **[Biotech]** **Adicet Bio reports Phase 1 data for gamma-delta CAR-T in lupus** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/adicet-gamma-delta-cell-therapy-lupus-study-results/831483/)
  * In an early-stage trial of lupus nephritis patients, 50% achieved a complete kidney response and 54% met remission criteria at one year post-treatment, with all evaluable patients discontinuing immunosuppressive drugs; no serious cytokine release syndrome or neurotoxicity was observed.
  * The company plans to initiate a pivotal trial in lupus in the fourth quarter.
* **[Biotech]** **Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals highlights Phase 1/2a data for ARO-MAPT** [BioStocks](https://www.biostocks.com)
  * Released interim clinical data from the Phase 1/2a study evaluating ARO-MAPT for Alzheimer’s disease and other tauopathies.
* **[Biotech]** **Compass Therapeutics presents Phase 2 CLOVER WaM subset data for iopofosine I 131** [BioStocks](https://www.biostocks.com)
  * Showcased efficacy data from the Phase 2 CLOVER WaM subset analysis of iopofosine I 131 in patients with Waldenström macroglobulinemia who are refractory or resistant to BTK inhibitors.
* **[Biotech]** **Novartis / Ionis dose first participant in Phase 2b SPINOZA trial for obicetrapib** [BioStocks](https://www.biostocks.com)
  * Initiated dosing in the Phase 2b SPINOZA trial evaluating obicetrapib in preclinical Alzheimer’s disease.
* **[Biotech]** **uniQure updates Phase 1/2 data for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/29/uniqure-huntingtons-gene-therapy-slows-disease-progression-four-years/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Four-year follow-up data from 12 high-dose patients in ongoing Phase 1/2 studies of ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130) showed continued slowing of disease progression, measured via cUHDRS (44% slowing, p=0.144) and Total Functional Capacity (TFC, 61% slowing, nominal p=0.008), though the magnitude of benefit waned compared to prior year analyses.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

* **[Biotech]** **Kodiak Sciences succeeds in Phase 3 wet AMD trials for Zenkuda and tabirafusp** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/kodiak-tabirafusp-wet-amd-daybreak-study-results/831467/)
  * Zenkuda matched Regeneron's Eylea in eyesight improvement in a Phase 3 trial using an individualized dosing strategy where over 50% of patients received injections every six months versus every eight weeks for Eylea.
  * A second candidate, tabirafusp alfa tedromer, also matched Eylea under a similar dosing schedule; Kodiak plans to file for FDA approval in wet AMD and two other eye disorders in Q4 2026.

4. **Regulatory & Approvals**

* **[Biotech]** **FDA approves Emcitate as first treatment for MCT8 deficiency** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-treatment-mct8-deficiency)
  * Approved Emcitate (tiratricol) tablets for oral suspension to treat peripheral thyrotoxicosis in patients with MCT8 deficiency (Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome), marking the first approved therapy to bypass the defective thyroid hormone transporter.
* **[Biotech]** **Unicycres resubmits NDA for oxylanthanum carbonate** [BioStocks](https://www.biostocks.com)
  * Resubmitted the NDA for oxylanthanum carbonate for hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease patients on dialysis, anticipating FDA acceptance within 30 days and a 6-month PDUFA timeline.

5. **Business & Strategy**

* **[Big Pharma]** **AstraZeneca commits $2B in equity and strategic partnership with Summit Therapeutics for ivonescimab** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/summit-astrazeneca-ivonescimab-deal-pd1-vegf/752865/)
  * Acquired approximately 109,000 shares of convertible preferred stock in Summit for $2 billion, representing a ~12% equity stake (~10.6% fully diluted).
  * The companies formed an alliance to evaluate ivonescimab combined with AstraZeneca oncology assets—initially pairing it with targeted cancer medicine Sone-Ve in gastrointestinal tumors, with plans to expand into antibody-drug conjugate combinations.
* **[Big Pharma]** **Merck discontinues Recarbio in the U.S.** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/09/28/merck-discontinues-antibiotic-recarbrio-in-u-s-despite-superbug-concerns/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Discontinued the commercial availability of Recarbio in the United States despite ongoing concerns regarding antimicrobial resistance and superbugs.
* **[Biotech]** **Kodiak expects $20M milestone payment from Takeda** [BioStocks](https://www.biostocks.com)
  * Announced an anticipated $20 million milestone payment under its elritercept license agreement with partner Takeda.
* **[Biotech]** **Iovance Biotherapeutics updates full-year sales guidance** [BioStocks](https://www.biostocks.com)
  * Raised its revenue outlook, driven by demand for Amtagvi and Proleukin, reflecting a $55 million midpoint increase over the prior $350 to $370 million range.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

* **[FDA]** **FDA signals intent to revamp PMTA regulatory framework** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-intends-evaluate-changes-pmta-regulatory-framework)
  * Citing implementation experience, litigation in the Northern District of Texas, and the proliferation of an illicit market, the agency announced plans to initiate rulemaking to replace the current Premarket Tobacco Product Application regulatory framework.
* **[Policy]** **CMS alters Medicare coverage pathway for breakthrough devices** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/09/29/fda-breakthrough-medical-devices-special-treatment-medicare/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * New medical devices granted "breakthrough" designation by the FDA will no longer receive automatic eligibility for extra Medicare add-on payments.

- Biology & Health
    - [Risks associated with thyroid supplements | Peter Attia, M.D.](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ySqrXczYpVg) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Standard blood tests for free T3 and free T4 are at their least reliable when accuracy is most critical, requiring specific testing before a diagnosis can be made.
        - The normal range for TSH increases naturally with age, and misinterpreting this elevation can lead to the unnecessary treatment of older adults.
        - The absorption of thyroid medication is highly sensitive to food and other interfering factors, making the timing of administration as critical as the dose itself.
        - When standard T4 therapy successfully normalizes lab values but the patient remains symptomatic, T3 can be added to the treatment regimen.
        - Testing of popular over-the-counter thyroid-support supplements has revealed discrepancies in their actual contents, highlighting the specific nutrients that truly matter for thyroid function.
